QUOTE: "It is passed directly as `ref={ref}` to `<NavigationSearch>` at `index.tsx:~124`, and only when `hasSearch` is true." and "When `hasSearch` is false, `NavigationSearch` is not mounted, so a ref passed to `NavigationHeader` stays null."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the forwarded ref goes to NavigationSearch, which is rendered only when hasSearch is true, so the ref stays null (attached to nothing) otherwise.
